title: Investigation of ground-water contamination at Solid Waste Management Unit 12, Naval Weapons Station Charleston, North Charleston, South Carolina
citation: Vroblesky, D.A., Casey, C.C., Petkewich, M.D., Lowery, M.A., Conlon, K.J., and Harrelson, L.G., 2007, Investigation of ground-water contamination at Solid Waste Management Unit 12, Naval Weapons Station Charleston, North Charleston, South Carolina: U.S. Geological Survey Scientific Investigations Report SIR-2006-5311, map scale 1:1,020.
notes: Report on chlorinated VOC ground-water contamination at SWMU12; no named stratigraphic units. Recorded hydrogeologic framework, lithology from boring logs described in text (p. 18), slug-test hydraulic conductivity (table 3, USGS 2005 column only; the Tetra Tech 2001, reanalysis and USGS 2003 columns on the left half were not recorded because column assignment is uncertain), and selected gradients and flow rates. Not recorded: VOC concentrations in soil (table 6) and ground water, water-table elevations on map figures (labels not reliably paired), age-dating table 4. Text on p. 18 gives 12MW-06S K as '0.9 to 0.21 ft/d' whereas table 3 gives 0.09 to 0.21.
